title: In-Cabin Monitoring with MiniDMS Model
description: This example demonstrates in-cabin driver monitoring using the MiniDMS model.
long_description: This example demonstrates in-cabin driver monitoring using the MiniDMS model. The system uses a camera to observe the driver and classify their behavior, helping to ensure safety and attention while driving.
